title: Cerberus validation harness for contextual calibration and profile gating
creator: Samir Kulkarni
description:
Summary:
Cerberus is an automated accuracy validation harness designed to run contextual calibration profiles (FP8/INT8) against curated sentinel prompts and real traffic cohorts, produce per-profile fidelity metrics, and produce deterministic pass/fail gating decisions for rollouts. The harness will integrate with CI, the rollout controller, and Console dashboards to block unsafe quantized variants before they reach production.

Goals:
- Provide reproducible, fast validation runs for candidate quant profiles (FP8/INT8) across representative contexts and prompt families.
- Measure a compact set of fidelity metrics (response token-level BLEU-ish suite, semantic similarity, logit-delta distribution, top-k agreement, and hallucination signal) and combine them into a transparent gating score.
- Support adaptive thresholds per-model and per-use-case cohort; surface explainable failure modes (layer sensitivity, context-length regressions).
- Emit telemetry, structured artifacts, and human-readable diffs for review; integrate with canary/A-B workflows and automatic rollback when regressions cross tolerance.

Acceptance criteria:
- Harness can accept a quant profile artifact and a validation job config, schedule evaluation across N=3 cohort sets (seeded-sentinel, sampled-real-traffic, adversarial-perturbations).
- Produces a JSON artifact with: metric breakdown, aggregate gate decision (PASS/FAIL), per-prompt diffs, and flagged examples (top 50 worst deltas).
- Gate rules are pluggable: default rule is weighted-sum with tunable weights; team can swap to policy that emphasizes safety/hallucination.
- End-to-end run time for a medium model (7B-class) on CI nodes must be < 90 minutes for the standard suite.
- CI integration: job exits non-zero on FAIL, posts artifact link to PR, and uploads summarized metrics to telemetry pipeline.

Design notes:
- Harness will use a layered execution model: 1) orchestrator (job scheduling, retries, artifact storage), 2) runner (batching, KV cache warm-starting, deterministic RNG seeds), 3) analyzer (metric calculators, weighted gate computation), 4) reporter (dashboard + PR comments + alerting).
- For deterministic comparisons we will use fixed seeds, tokenizer normalization steps, and a replayable KV cache priming process for long-context scenarios.
- Metric choices: "token_stability" (fraction of token-by-token matches), "semantic_similarity" (embedding cosine with thresholded aggregation), "logit_shift" (per-token KL/logit-delta summary), "rerank_discrepancy" (ranking shifts for top-N candidates), and "hallucination_delta" (entity hallucination delta against ground truth or knowledge checks).
- Gate decision: provide default thresholds but support per-customer relaxations for low-risk workloads via rollout policies in Console.

Integration and artifacts:
- Artifacts stored in S3/GCS with signed links and retention policy 90 days.
- PR integration: post a compact summary plus link to full artifact. Example PR comment template will include PASS/FAIL, key metrics, top-3 bad examples, and a link to the per-example diffs.
- Console: new "Validation Runs" view under model page showing run history, metric trends, and per-profile badges.

Telemetry & monitoring:
- Emit metrics to telemetry: validation.run.duration, validation.run.result (PASS/FAIL), validation.metric.{name}.pXX quantiles.
- Alerting: team-defined SLA on regression frequency. If a profile that previously passed begins failing in continuous runs, we create an auto-ticket to triage.

Testing plan:
- Unit tests for analyzer components and metric calculators.
- Integration tests using a small sample model in CI and a mocked orchestrator to validate artifact formats.
- Smoke-run in staging with one FP8 and one INT8 profile against the seeded sentinel set.
- Performance test to ensure end-to-end < 90 minutes for medium model; will be measured in dedicated CI shards.

Rollout plan:
- Phase 1 (staging): run harness nightly against canary profiles, surface Console UI.
- Phase 2 (alpha): gate canary rollouts for internal teams; collect feedback and tune thresholds.
- Phase 3 (GA): enable harness gating as optional enforcement on Dedicated and Hosted rollouts; document configuration in runbooks.

Risks & mitigations:
- Flaky comparisons due to nondeterministic ops: mitigate with seeds, isolated runner images, and reproducible tokenizer versions.
- Too slow for CI: provide fast/strict and slow/deep suites; only the deep suite used for release candidates.
- False positives where semantic difference is acceptable: allow per-model/per-use-case threshold overrides and manual review flow.

References and links:
- Design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Cerberus+validation+harness (draft)
- Example artifact format (schema): gs://redwood-validation-schemas/cerberus_v1.json
- Related tickets: ENG-7521 (quant validation harness), ENG-314159 (profile verifier), ENG-47211 (calibration roadrunner)
